career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Department of Economic and Policy Research (DEPR) specialize in monetary policy analysis, macroeconomic forecasting, and financial regulation research, advancing through the central bank's elite economic research hierarchy up to Deputy Governor in charge of monetary policy.

exam_scheme.note: RBI Grade 'B' (DEPR) selection involves Phase I (Objective Economics), Phase II (Descriptive Economics & English), and Phase III (Personal Interview). Unlike the General stream, Paper I marks are added to the final merit score.

stages.stage_name: Phase I: Paper I (Online Objective - Economics)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Cut-off marks for Phase II shortlisting; marks counted for final selection

stages.stage_name: Phase II: Written Examination (Descriptive Economics and English)

papers.paper_name: Paper II: Economics (Descriptive - Macroeconomics, Monetary Economics & Indian Economy)
Paper III: English (Descriptive - Essay, Precis Writing & Comprehension)

papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit based on aggregate of Paper I (100) + Paper II (100) + Paper III (100) + Interview (75) = 375 marks

financial_package.estimate_note: Starting basic pay is ₹78,450 in the scale ₹78,450 - 4050(9) - 114,900 - EB - 4050(2) - 123,000 - 4650(4) - 141,600 (16 years). Total monthly gross emoluments at Mumbai reach approx. ₹1,16,000 to ₹1,45,000 inclusive of basic, DA (58% review baseline), Grade Allowance, Special Allowance, Local Compensatory Allowance, Learning Allowance, and Bank Residential Quarters / HRA.
official_perks: Bank Leased Residential Accommodation (in central bank officer colonies in Mumbai and regional centres) or HRA
Dispensary facilities and 100% medical expense reimbursement for self and eligible dependents
Leave Fare Concession (LFC) once in two years for officer and family
Monthly Fuel / Petrol Allowance (up to 150-180 litres per month depending on posting)
Book Grant, Newspaper Allowance, and Briefcase Grant
Concessional Staff Housing Loan, Car Loan, and Education Loan schemes
Defined Contributory Pension Scheme under National Pension System (NPS)

competition_benchmarks.note: Competition benchmarks reflect specialist recruitment by the Reserve Bank of India Services Board for postgraduate economists.
